design_acceptance.requirement: Source-derived surface and executable-entrypoint closure maps routes APIs handlers dependencies middleware lifecycle background CLI watch callbacks frontend events timers storage network and dynamic dispatch production symbols and persisted capabilities exactly once; semantic or effect exclusions need executable evidence and drift blocks.
Nine domain specs use independent observations and finite state terminal recovery contracts with current historical malformed stale and interrupted fixtures as applicable.
A source-bound hazard profile derives minimum risk tier and all obligations; downgrade blocks and each N/A has absent-callsite evidence plus an executable infeasibility witness.

A source-derived producer-consumer inventory exactly reconciles the DAG enforces identity freshness rebuild-or-stale closure blocks wrong and mixed generations and derives producer-consumer race schedules.
Contextual Permission is an exact retained Phase 2 prerequisite and cannot be weakened by the aggregate adapter.

A source-to-authority-sink manifest enforces safety privacy candidate confirmation and admission boundaries; receipts bind exact subject and policy identities and sentinels prove non-propagation through every output log and error projection.

A total effect-operation inventory and source plus replay-derived command resource sets derive all fault and intra or cross-domain schedule cells; faults use fresh processes and workbenches and every uncovered or unactivated cell blocks.

Domain and cross-domain mutants have isolated activation and exact attribution including tier N-A non-route entrypoint dependency conflict receipt staleness workspace TOCTOU stale or mixed aggregate and retained false-pass classes.

Explicit active-workspace inventory is a complete read-only metadata-bounded sealed snapshot; unknown entries block path aliases mounts hardlinks escape and concurrent mutation are detected and every capability reconciles to support migration or quarantine.

All and release modes have distinct claims; aggregate canonical identity atomic output projection parity exact run binding and total exit semantics prevent omitted-domain stale-run or incomplete-evidence passes.

Closure evidence includes focused domain and cross-domain tests retained Phase 1 and 2 regressions source-manifest recomputation and exact per-domain aggregate fault schedule mutation and projection reconciliation.
Phase 3 remains internal pre-release qualification separate from runtime Diagnostic UI and makes no unearned production real-workspace runtime-safety outbound or hardware claim.
